operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) There is hereby established the President's Commission on Campus Unrest (hereinafter referred to as the Commission).

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The Commission shall be composed of a Chairman to be appointed by the President, and of so many other members as the President may appoint.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 2. Functions of the Commission. The Commission shall study dissent, disorder, and violence on the campuses of institutions of higher learning or in connection with such institutions, and report its findings and recommendations to the President. The duties of the Commission shall include, but not be limited to, the following:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 2 (lead-in)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (1) Identifying the principal causes of campus violence and the breakdown in the process of orderly expression of dissent on the campus.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 2(1)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (2) Suggesting specific methods and procedures through which grievances can be resolved by means other than the exertion of force.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 2(2)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (3) Suggesting ways to protect academic freedom, the right to obtain an education free from improper interference, and the right of peaceful dissent and protest.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 2(3)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (4) Proposing practical steps which can be taken by government at all levels, by the administrations of institutions of higher learning, and by students, through student governments or otherwise, to minimize dangers attendant upon expressions of dissent.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 2(4)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) The Commission shall have an Executive Director, appointed by the President in accordance with law.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 3(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) Subject to law, the Commission is authorized (1) to appoint such additional personnel as it deems necessary and fix their compensation, and (2) to obtain services in accordance with the provisions of 5 U.S.C. 3109.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 3(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 4. Expenses. Members of the Commission shall receive compensation of $100 per day when engaged in the performance of duties under this order and shall be allowed travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, as authorized by law (5 U.S.C. 5703) for persons in Government service employed intermittently.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 4

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) The Commission, acting through its chairman, is authorized to request from any executive department or agency any information and assistance deemed necessary to carry out its functions under this order. Each department and agency is directed, to the extent permitted by law and within the limits of available funds, to furnish information and assistance to the Commission.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 5(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The General Services Administration shall provide administrative services and support for the Commission.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 5(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 6. Report and termination. The Commission shall present its final report and recommendations to the President not later than October 1, 1970, and shall terminate thirty days after the presentation of such report.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 6
